name: Picker
description: Pick a color from anywhere on your screen and copy it as HEX, RGB or HSL.
author: Giuseppe
details: A color picker for anything on your screen. Click Pick a color, point at a pixel and click: the color is copied as HEX, RGB or HSL, and the last ones stay in the options to copy again.
features: Pick from anywhere on the screen
The last 8 colors to copy again
